inputMethod: Read-only NodeIO+Draco decode of all16 final native32 GLBs; no production palm selector called. Independent polygon clipping against x/y/Hand-mass halfspaces, then maximum fixed support projection over clipped polygon vertices.

canonicalAxesEvidence.thumbExpansionOutsideHeelDomain: Thumb-side surface reaches |X| above30mm distal to aboutY=-45mm; heel box X±15mm excludes that lateral lobe.

limitations: This validates the anatomical heel domain, actual triangle witnesses and crease-ray bias only. It is not a pass for dynamic support, no-penetration,3mm residuals or interrupted transitions.

Independent per-LOD support maxima can select different lateral heel pads. A matched paired-LOD selector is a separate production candidate and must be independently validated; the maxima here are not asserted as its final witness.
Bare hands use Skin; goalkeeper gloves retain anatomical skin topology with a4mm source inflation and use Cloth. Recorded triangles always come from the actual respective material.
